claim: One published intensive Claude Code workload modeled 170 kWh across 1,138 human requests, or about 149 Wh per request, because each request can trigger many model calls, tool operations, and iterations.
shortLabel: Coding agents are a separate cost class
comparisonContext: This is the conceptual bridge between the prompt-comparison page and the heavy-use scenario page.
scopeNote: This is a modeled intensive-use example, not a general user average or a provider benchmark. The exact Claude model mix was not reported, and the project's water values are transferred from its shared AI water method rather than measured in this workload.
sourceTitle: The real energy use of agentic AI
